meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: 自动把任务拆成多个能独立合并的小改动,每个改动在独立工作区里完成;强制先在真实环境做人工测试并保存证据,再写英文说明;随后跑自动检查与 AI 审核,全部通过后自动合并。
howto.when: 当你说出「创建 PR」「实现并提交 PR」等关键词,或要求把改动作为 PR 合并,甚至只说「实现 X」但语境明显需要提交 PR 时,就会触发。

say.text: 把这批改动拆成几个小的独立 PR,分别处理。
say.note: 按依赖顺序拆分,并行创建多个工作区。

say.text: 实现这个 issue,并作为 PR 提上去。
say.note: 走完整流程:实现、人工验证、写说明、自动合并。

say.text: 把这个功能做成 PR,通过检查后自动合并。
say.note: CI 和 Cubic 审核通过后合并,然后清理工作区。

howto.what_en: Splits the task into small, independently mergeable PRs. Each is developed in its own worktree with mandatory manual QA on a real surface, then written up in English. Runs CI and Cubic review, and merges automatically once all gates pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', or any similar request to land work as a pull request, even a bare 'implement X' when context implies PR delivery.

say_en.text: Split these changes into small independent PRs and handle them.
say_en.note: Splits by dependency and runs parallel worktrees.

say_en.text: Implement this issue and raise it as a PR.
say_en.note: Runs full lifecycle: implement, manual QA, PR, auto-merge.

say_en.text: Turn this feature into a PR and merge it after checks pass.
say_en.note: Merges after CI and Cubic pass, then cleans up.
